name: ESLint
summary: Static analysis for JavaScript and TypeScript, driven by a flat config the repo owns.

name: Prettier
summary: Opinionated formatter. Running it in CI removes formatting from code review entirely.

name: TypeScript
summary: Type checking as a build gate. Catches the class of bug tests rarely reach.

name: Trivy
summary: Scans lockfiles, images and IaC for known vulnerabilities. Skips devDependencies unless told otherwise.

name: Kingfisher
summary: Secret scanning that validates findings against the issuing API, so a live credential is distinguishable from a lookalike.

name: Semgrep
summary: Pattern-based SAST with rules that read like the code they match.

name: actionlint
summary: Lints GitHub Actions workflows, including the inline shell, before a push proves it wrong.

name: Vitest
summary: Unit and integration test runner with first-class TypeScript and coverage reporting.

name: Playwright
summary: Browser-level end-to-end tests, run against a real build rather than a dev server.

name: Renovate
summary: Automated dependency updates, grouped and scheduled so the noise stays manageable.

name: Codecov
summary: Coverage reporting with per-PR deltas. Useful as a signal, hazardous as a hard gate.

name: SpotBugs
summary: Bytecode-level static analysis for JVM projects, wired into the shared Java CI stack.
